name: fade-moving-track
description: Fade the moving action track during entrance

edits.old: @keyframes workbench-tool-enter { from { transform: translateX(var(--workbench-tool-distance, 100%)); } to { transform: translateX(0); } }
edits.new: @keyframes workbench-tool-enter { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(var(--workbench-tool-distance, 100%)); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } }

name: ignore-reduced-motion
description: Do not suppress animation for reduced motion
